note: Starter list of Windows process names sometimes bundled by old installers as toolbars, ad-injection helpers or upsell nagware. Device Health only ever shows these as a suggestion next to the process in the background-processes list — nothing here is ever closed automatically. This list deliberately excludes anything resembling antivirus or security software; it's a small, low-risk starting point meant to be extended over time, not an exhaustive database.

entries.label: Ask Toolbar updater
entries.reason: Leftover updater from the old Ask.com browser toolbar, often bundled with unrelated installers.

entries.label: Ask Toolbar service
entries.reason: Background service for the Ask.com browser toolbar.

entries.label: Babylon Toolbar
entries.reason: Tray helper for the Babylon browser toolbar, a bundled adware toolbar.

entries.label: Babylon Toolbar popups
entries.reason: Popup helper for the Babylon browser toolbar.

entries.label: Conduit Search Protect updater
entries.reason: Updater for Conduit Search Protect, a browser-hijacking toolbar.

entries.label: Conduit Search Protect helper
entries.reason: Background helper for Conduit Search Protect.

entries.label: Smartbar / Snap.Do
entries.reason: Ad-injecting browser toolbar commonly bundled with free software installers.

entries.label: DealPly
entries.reason: Ad-injection adware that shows coupon and deal popups.

entries.label: Wajam
entries.reason: Ad-injection adware that alters search results and web pages.

entries.label: MyPC Backup
entries.reason: Subscription upsell nagware for an online backup service.

entries.label: RegCleanPro
entries.reason: Registry-cleaner upsell nagware with limited real benefit.

entries.label: iLivid
entries.reason: Bundled download manager known for adware and toolbar installs.

entries.label: HP Software Update Scheduler
entries.reason: Optional HP update checker — disabling it doesn't stop your printer or PC working.

entries.label: HP Software Update Trigger
entries.reason: Optional HP update-check helper, not required for normal use.
